title: KnowledgeClaw: Towards Agentic Knowledge Engineering via Omnimodal Hypergraphs
abstract: arXiv:2611.24294v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Knowledge engineering (KE) turns raw files into a reasoning-ready knowledge base, a task now within reach of LLM agents. KE has progressed from chunk and graph retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to memory agents, agentic KE and multimodal KE. However, a live knowledge base needs omnimodality, a closed-loop lifecycle and multi-granular application at once, yet existing systems meet at most two and no benchmark measures all three. We formalize Omnimodal Knowledge Engineering (OmniKE) and release OmniKE-Bench, six tasks with 1,829 model-free items over 3,960 real files in five modalities. We further propose KnowledgeClaw, an agentic system that builds an omnimodal typed hypergraph, keeps it current with a closed-loop lifecycle agent and routes each query to the granularity it needs. Against 30 baselines, it ranks first on all six tasks with an overall OKE of 55.9, +14.6 over the strongest baseline. Our software and data are publicly avail

translated_title: KnowledgeClaw：基于全模态超图的智能体知识工程
translated_abstract: 知识工程（KE）将原始文件转化为可供推理的知识库，这一任务如今已在大语言模型智能体的能力范围之内。知识工程已经从分块检索和图检索增强生成（RAG）发展到记忆智能体、智能体知识工程和多模态知识工程。然而，一个“活的”知识库需要同时具备全模态、闭环生命周期和多粒度应用这三种能力，而现有系统最多只能满足其中两项，且没有任何基准能够同时衡量这三方面。我们形式化了全模态知识工程（OmniKE），并发布了OmniKE-Bench基准，该基准包含六项任务、1,829个不依赖特定模型的项目，覆盖五种模态的3,960个真实文件。我们进一步提出了KnowledgeClaw，这是一个智能体系统，它构建全模态类型化超图，通过闭环生命周期智能体保持知识库的持续更新，并将每个查询路由到所需的知识粒度。与30个基线相比，该系统在全部六项任务上均排名第一，总体OKE分数达到55.9，比最强基线高出14.6。相关软件和数据均已公开。
tldr: 论文形式化了全模态知识工程任务并发布OmniKE-Bench基准，提出基于全模态类型化超图与闭环生命周期智能体的KnowledgeClaw系统，在六项任务上全面超越30个基线，总体OKE领先最强基线14.6分。
en_tdlr: The paper formalizes Omnimodal Knowledge Engineering and introduces the OmniKE-Bench benchmark, proposing KnowledgeClaw, an agentic system that builds omnimodal typed hypergraphs with a closed-loop lifecycle agent, ranking first on all six tasks and outperforming 30 baselines by 14.6 overall OKE.
